question: Explain the historical background behind the emergence of the Silhak (Practical Learning) movement in late Joseon Korea, and describe its principal schools of thought.
Explain how the Korean alphabet Hunminjeongeum was created during the Joseon dynasty, and describe the court officials who submitted memorials opposing its adoption.
Explain the major naval engagements of the Imjin War of 1592-1598 and the commanders who led the Korean fleet.
Explain the conflict between the Sarim and Hungu factions in early Joseon Korea, and the four literati purges that resulted.
Explain the circumstances under which the Samguk Sagi and the Samguk Yusa were compiled during the Goryeo period, and how the two works differ in purpose and method.
Explain how the Gapsin Coup of 1884 unfolded in Korea, and describe the principal figures of the Enlightenment Party who led it.
